positions.description: Area Tech Lead for Google Map's Automotive API stack

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: I manage the ~40 person Routing and Navigation Platform at Google which provides all driving, walking and biking directions across all of Google's surfaces (Google Maps, Google Search, Google Maps Platform, Android Automotive) as well as the core software layer that powers on-device navigation in Google Maps and Google Navigation SDK

positions.title: Principal Lead Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for a number of positions over seven years at Microsoft, all within the Xbox organization

2006-2008.  Senior Software Development Engineer, XNA LIVE Server.  Responsible for the design, architecture and implementation of online social features exclusively for Microsoft Game Studio titles such as Forza Motorsports and Gears of War.
2009-2010.  Senior lead software development engineer, Xbox LIVE Core Platform Team.  Lead a small team responsible for the core services platform for Xbox LIVE.  My team was responsible for building the tools and services required for deployment, management and monitoring of Xbox LIVE.  My team was also involved in various aspects of Kinect, predominately building systems for collecting and analyzing large quantities of test data.
2011-2013.  Principal Lead Software Development Engineer, Xbox LIVE Laboratories.  Starting with a team of two that grew into a team of nearly 40, was responsible for an unannounced Xbox LIVE service.  In the team's infancy, was responsible for architecting the service as well as a substantial portion of its implementation.  As the team grew, I took a position managing the services team and working across Xbox to build this next generation service.
